grading_scale.A: historical source plus at least one clearly independent modern Rarámuri witness or multi-variety elicitation, with strong semantic/formal alignment
grading_scale.A-: same general standard with one significant formal or mapping problem still unresolved
grading_scale.B: strong historical-modern match but modern evidence independence is unresolved or concentrated in one lineage
grading_scale.B-: promising candidate with source-internal modern support but lacking independent modern replication

research_rule: Evidential strength is based on independent source families, not raw number of documents. A critical edition analyzing Steffel does not count as a second historical witness; revised editions and probable derivatives of Hilton do not count as independent modern witnesses; comparative works citing Hilton do not create a new Rarámuri attestation.
